text: {{ (() => { const b = appsmith.store.selectedBill || {}; const m = appsmith.store.selectedMeter || {}; return [ `### Bill #${b.IdBill || '—'}   ·   Invoice ${b.InvoiceNumber || '—'}   ·   Total $${b.TotalDue || 0}`, '', `**Client:** ${b.ClientName || b.IdClient || '—'}      **Vendor:** ${b.VendorName || '—'}      **Utility type:** ${m.serviceType || '—'}`, `**Account #:** ${b.AccountNumber_Raw || b.AccountNumber || '—'}      **Arcadia account id:** \`${b.ArcadiaAccountId || '—'}\``, `**Meter #:** ${m.meterNumber || m.normalizedMeterNumber || '—'}      **Arcadia meter id:** \`${m.id || appsmith.store.intervalsMeterId || '—'}\``, `**Service period:** ${appsmith.store.intervalsStartDate || '—'} → ${appsmith.store.intervalsEndDate || '—'}      **Invoice date:** ${b.InvoiceDate || '—'}`, `**Service address:** ${m.serviceAddress?.fullAddress || '—'}` ].join('\n'); })() }}
